BiblicalUsage: Tochu is one link in Elkanah's chain. Samuel's father was the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, and the name is spelled Tochu in the lexicon and Tohu in the King James.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy is there to be read whole: Samuel's line runs through men whose names we would otherwise never know, and Tohu's place in it is what makes Samuel an Ephrathite of Mount Ephraim.
